item.title: Garbage Collection Systems And Myths
item.description: Basic Memory Manager /** * @brief MemoryManager state. * */ typedef struct memory_manager_t { HashTable* buffer_map; ///< Pointer to size map. . . . } MemoryManager; MemoryManager* MemoryManagerCreate(); void MemoryManagerDestroy(MemoryManager* m); . . . Writing memory managers are a difficult task. We have two basic options. First one is that we implement a full blown Garbage Collector that can scan the entire stack and heap for possible memory regions having no reference stored anywhere anymore, other is we implement a Memory Checker that’ll check if allocated memory objects are free’d or not.
